newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan inflation falls to 34 pct by mid July.
newsitem.headline: Sudan inflation falls to 34 pct by mid July.

text.p: Sudanese Minister of Finance Abdel Wahhab Osman was quoted on Wednesday as saying Sudan's inflation has fallen to 34 percent in the middle of July from 41 percent at the end of June.

The daily al-Anbaa newspaper in its report gave no figures for inflation at the end of June, 1996, but government officials say the official inflation rate of 166 percent in August, 1996 has been steadily falling.
Osman attributed the fall to public expenditure policies imposed since August. He gave no details but Sudan has imposed strict policies to rationalise public spending and clamp down on money supply.
